name: terminalssh

scripts.dist:linux: pnpm icons && pnpm build && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.dist:linux:appimage: pnpm icons && pnpm build && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage
scripts.dist:linux:rpm: pnpm icons && pnpm build && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux rpm
scripts.dist:win: pnpm icons && pnpm build && pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
